description.value:
Enemies affected by the white mage's light spells must make a Will save (DC = 10 + Spell Level + Wisdom modifier) or gain a Mark of Light for 1d6 rounds. If an ally of the white mage (not including themselves) hits a creature bearing a Mark of Light with a melee or ranged attack, that creature takes 2d4 points of additional holy damage and takes a -2 penalty to all saving throws for a number of rounds equal to half the white mage's Wisdom modifier. The Mark of Light is then removed from the creature.

Asterisk talent: only one such talent's effect may be applied to an individual spell; decision made before casting.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Advanced Mage Talents)
